%d files need retry. Other selected files continue importing.

resources.string: If an image fails, its error is kept and other images continue. Resume retries only failed or unfinished selected files. Verified imports are kept.
XMP annotation backup is separate from importing originals. If its catalogue exceeds 2 MiB, annotations remain on this phone and that backup needs attention; image imports continue.
